definition: Canonical GW event/source identity. Aliases may be linked only by explicit release metadata or a frozen alias table; string similarity alone is insufficient.
Exact ordered/unordered event membership frame used by an analysis.
Exact catalog/data/public-release identity and version (for example GWTC/GWOSC/O4a/O4b context).
Exact parameter-estimation posterior release/product lineage used upstream.
Population-analysis frame including event count/type constraints such as 235 CBC or 231 BBH.
Pipeline/model/waveform/configuration identity needed to distinguish method changes from release/frame changes.
Exact public artifact or payload identity, including filename/checksum where available.
Detector/site identity for strain/DQ/calibration products.
Exact public strain release/data product identity.
Exact selection-function/injection public release or campaign identity.
Injection campaign/sample identity used to estimate selection effects.
Exact remnant/ringdown summary schema and field semantics.
Exact external/public release being used for independent replication/transport comparison.
Exact source frame/event population entering the cosmology result.
Cosmology route such as spectral/dark/bright-combined, with exact product semantics.
Exact released posterior product representation (samples versus grid+density, etc.).
Named inference/search/cosmology pipeline identity.
Named population model identity.
Galaxy/event catalog identity and release.
Catalog weighting convention such as luminosity or uniform.
Physical/summary parameter name plus units/semantics.
